headline: South Korea tax exam top scorer admits using AI to cheat
summary: The top scorer on South Korea's national tax accountancy exam admitted to cheating with AI. One report says he sent photos of exam questions to a generative AI tool, while another says he used a hidden camera and AI, identifying him as Han Won-seok, 34.
